name: code-craft
description: Two architecture skills. clean-architecture — Clean Architecture feature implementation for any stack, mobile (Flutter, Android, iOS, React Native), web frontend, backend service, or desktop, with bundled mappings for the four mobile stacks and Node backends and every other stack derived live from the project's own conventions. compose-screen-architecture — the screen layer for Android Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform, Route/Screen split, state ownership, ViewModel scope and lifetimes, outcomes and restoration, platform UI adapters, KMP versus Android-only placement; everything below the ViewModel hands off to clean-architecture. Project conventions are detected first and always win over either skill's defaults.

interface.shortDescription: Build features with Clean Architecture and Compose screens
interface.longDescription: Implement, extend, or refactor a feature with Clean Architecture in whatever stack the project already uses — mobile, web frontend, backend service, or desktop. Code Craft enforces one dependency direction and nothing else: packages, naming, folder shape, state management, and error idiom are detected from the project and always win over the skill's defaults. It profiles the project, proposes the design before writing code, builds inside-out with a gate at each layer, then verifies against the project's own tests and dependency checks. Existing violations are reported, never copied and never silently rewritten; where the project's shape contradicts the layer contract, it stops and asks rather than deciding alone. compose-screen-architecture covers the Compose screen layer — Route/Screen split, state ownership, ViewModel lifetimes, outcomes and restoration — and hands everything below the ViewModel to clean-architecture.
capabilities: Implement a feature with Clean Architecture
Refactor a feature onto clean layers
Build or audit a Compose screen with sound state ownership and lifetimes
defaultPrompt: Implement this feature with Clean Architecture in this project's own conventions.
This screen calls the API directly — refactor it onto clean layers.
Propose the layer design for this feature before writing any code.
Create the address-edit Compose screen — Route, Screen, ViewModel — in this project's conventions.
